experiment: Reuse evaluated hot log labels within a query
selection: Saved CPU reports attribute hot matching and assembly; the allocation capture records 2024592 string-clone calls through evaluator, matcher and hot appender. Cold collector attribution is absent from these reports. These diagnostics do not qualify CPU or RSS savings.
guard: Reuse only with empty pipeline and empty structured metadata. Standard HashMap compares complete label values and caches matcher misses. Preserve per-record admission, deletion, frontier, timestamps, lines and metadata. Tail retains its original path; distinct uses the pipeline fallback.
prepared_check: Complete folded and categorized responses for independent equal labels, different label sets, rejected labels, metadata and pipeline fallbacks, known and unknown levels, tenant/window/deletion/frontier boundaries.
negative_control_to_run: Remove the per-record metadata guard: the complete-response ledger must reject reuse of metadata-free labels for the metadata-bearing row.
scope_limit: Per-row hashing and cache entries can regress predominantly unique labels. No retained memory advantage is assumed.
next_action: Measure the separate metrics candidate first, then apply and validate this draft and run fixed-source GCP comparisons.
